subject: proj-dy
title: PROJ.DY.------INFO.DY.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 385 (JR-7). PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) is the subject; INFO-DY is the partner. From the subject: TH-CONT (thrust continuance), LK-IMP (linkage implications) and TRS (transition). From TH-CONT: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From T-C-IMP: RT-ALGN (reality alignment). From RT-ALGN: SCI-DY (scientific dynamics). From LK-IMP: POST (postulation) and PER-VT-U-FUND (perceived vibrational universe fundamental). From PER-VT-U-FUND: C-CONT (composite continuance). From C-CONT: PRI-AF-TD (primary affinity tendencies). From PRI-AF-TD: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics).
